hints.title: City Partition Ranking
hints.text: Partition weather recordings by city_id, ordering by degree descending, then day ascending.

hints.title: Row Number Assignment
hints.text: Use row number within the partition so that the record with highest degree and earliest day receives rank 1.

hints.title: Filtering Top Record
hints.text: Select records where rank equals 1, ordered by city_id ascending.

hints.title: Ranked First Day Query
hints.text:
```sql
WITH Ranked AS (
  SELECT city_id, day, degree,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city_id ORDER BY degree DESC, day ASC) AS rn
  FROM Weather
)
SELECT city_id, day, degree
FROM Ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY city_id;
```

complexity.time: O(n log n) window ranking per city
complexity.notes: Partition sort breaks degree ties using chronological order.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grouping by max(degree) alone requires re-joining with weather table on degree and min(day).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) memory to compute row numbers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate resolves ties for highest degree by selecting earliest day cleanly using row_number.
